user.title: Connect the light
user.description: How should Home Assistant send commands to the light?

menu_options.local: Local MQTT (light runs the local-MQTT custom firmware; no cloud)
menu_options.pixeld: Custom firmware with pixeld (local MQTT, light draws and rotates itself)

cloud.title: Govee account
cloud.description: Log in with the Govee Home account that owns the pixel light. Images are served from Home Assistant on your LAN; only the short 'show this' command goes through Govee's cloud.

local.title: Local MQTT
local.description: For a light running the local-MQTT custom firmware, bridged to this Home Assistant's MQTT broker. Home Assistant's MQTT integration must be set up. The light is checked by asking it for its status on `<prefix>cmd` and waiting for its reply on `<prefix>state`.

data_description.topic_prefix: Must match MQTT_PREFIX in the light's bridge settings (default govee/h8630/).

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Govee emailed a verification code to {email}. Enter it to finish logging in.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Govee rejected the saved session for {email}. Enter the password to log in again.

pixeld.title: Light running pixeld
pixeld.description: For a light on the custom firmware in native mode (pixeld). Home Assistant's MQTT integration must be set up.

reconfigure.title: Light protocol
reconfigure.description: Switch between the custom firmware's two modes. The device, its entities and their history are kept.

error.invalid_code: The verification code was not accepted.
error.no_devices: No Govee pixel light (H8630) found on this account.
error.mqtt_unavailable: Home Assistant's MQTT integration is not set up or not connected, or the light's bridge reports it is down.
error.no_reply: The light did not answer on that topic prefix. Check the prefix and that the light's bridge is connected (<prefix>bridge/state = 1).
error.no_pixeld: No pixeld light answered under that topic prefix (nothing on <prefix>px/info). Is native mode on?

abort.already_configured: This Govee account or light is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different Govee account.
abort.device_in_cloud_entry: This light is already set up through a Govee account entry. Remove that entry first to control it over local MQTT.
abort.not_local: Only local (MQTT) lights can switch protocol.

init.title: Options
init.description: The light downloads every image and playlist item from Home Assistant over HTTP. Leave the base URL empty to use this Home Assistant's LAN IP and port, or set it (for example http://192.168.1.10:8123) if the light cannot reach the default.

data.reclaim: Re-apply the playlist if the light shows something else

data_description.playback: On the light: Home Assistant sends the whole playlist once and the light rotates by itself. From Home Assistant: Home Assistant sends each item in turn (one command per item).
data_description.resume: Re-send the playlist (confirmed by the light; items it already has are not downloaded again), or only switch the light back to its stored playlist (cheaper, experimental).
data_description.refresh_minutes: Weather, URL and camera items are redrawn this often; the light only downloads items whose picture changed.
data_description.encoder: PNG frames is verified on the H8630. Automatic also uses the light's native GIF format when that is lossless and smaller (experimental).
data_description.reclaim: Checked at each refresh and as soon as the light is switched back on: if the light is on but not showing the playlist (e.g. after a power cut, or a scene picked in the Govee app), the playlist is sent again. Automatic re-sends wait while the light is off.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Show a picture or animated GIF on the pixel light. Give exactly one of path, URL or entity.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) to show the image on.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: If the playlist is playing, it resumes after this many seconds (default 60; 0 keeps this on screen until govee_pixel.playlist_resume). Ignored when no playlist is playing.

image_path.name: File path
image_path.description: Local file, e.g. /config/www/govee/weather.gif (must be in allowlist_external_dirs; /config/www and /media are allowed by default).

image_entity.name: Image or camera entity
image_entity.description: Use the current picture of an image or camera entity.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: How to fit non-square images onto the 32x32 matrix.

resample.name: Scaling filter
resample.description: Nearest keeps pixel art crisp; Lanczos is best for photos.

background.name: Background
background.description: Colour behind transparent pixels and letterbox bars.

frame_duration.name: Frame duration
frame_duration.description: Override the time each frame is shown (default: the GIF's own timing, or 100 ms).

max_frames.name: Max frames
max_frames.description: Longer animations are thinned out to this many frames (device limit 100).

show_weather.name: Show weather
show_weather.description: Show an animated weather icon with the temperature, or a 3-day forecast, drawn on the light. Use a weather entity, or give a condition and temperature.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) to show it on.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: If the playlist is playing, it resumes after this many seconds (default 60; 0 keeps this on screen until govee_pixel.playlist_resume). Ignored when no playlist is playing.

weather_entity.name: Weather entity
weather_entity.description: Take the condition, temperature and unit from this weather entity.

forecast.name: 3-day forecast
forecast.description: Show the next three days (icon, high, low) from the weather entity's daily forecast instead of current conditions.

condition.name: Condition
condition.description: Weather condition, e.g. sunny, rainy, snowy (overrides the entity's).

temperature_unit.name: Temperature unit
temperature_unit.description: Used to pick the temperature colour. Defaults to the entity's or your system's unit.

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Show a message in a chunky pixel font. Short text is centred, longer text scrolls.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) to show it on.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: If the playlist is playing, it resumes after this many seconds (default 60; 0 keeps this on screen until govee_pixel.playlist_resume). Ignored when no playlist is playing.

message.name: Message
message.description: Letters, digits and basic punctuation (shown in capitals).

color.name: Colour
color.description: Text colour. Leave empty for a rainbow.

size.name: Size
size.description: Large fits about 4 characters on screen at once, small about 8.

frame_duration.name: Speed
frame_duration.description: Milliseconds for the text to move one pixel (lower is faster). Default 50, about 20 pixels a second.

color_effect.name: Colour effect
color_effect.description: None: the colour above. Rainbow: every letter a different colour, flowing along the message. Cycle: the whole message changing colour. Default: rainbow without a colour, otherwise none.

motion.name: Motion
motion.description: Bounce: the text hops up and down as it goes. Wave: the letters ripple.

sparkles.name: Sparkles
sparkles.description: Stars twinkle above and below the text.

show_animation.name: Show animation
show_animation.description: Show one of the built-in animated scenes.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) to show it on.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: If the playlist is playing, it resumes after this many seconds (default 60; 0 keeps this on screen until govee_pixel.playlist_resume). Ignored when no playlist is playing.

playlist_add.name: Add or update playlist item
playlist_add.description: Add an item to the light's playlist, or replace the item with the same name. Up to 20 items.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) whose playlist to change.

name.name: Name
name.description: Unique name; adding an existing name updates that item.

options.name: Options
options.description: The same fields as the matching show_* action, e.g. {"weather_entity": "weather.home"} or {"image_path": "/config/www/govee/cat.gif"}.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds on screen (the light rounds animations up to whole loops).

position.name: Position
position.description: 0 = first. Default: end of the list (or the item's current place when updating).

show_if.name: Show if
show_if.description: Template: the item is in the rotation only while this is true (pixeld). Re-checked when the entities it uses change.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) whose playlist to change.

playlist_clear.name: Clear playlist
playlist_clear.description: Remove every item (and stop the playlist).

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) whose playlist to change.

playlist_resume.name: Resume playlist
playlist_resume.description: Resume the playlist now after an interruption.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) whose playlist to change.

playlist_refresh.name: Refresh playlist
playlist_refresh.description: Redraw every item now and re-send the playlist.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Pixel light(s) whose playlist to change.
